name: arduino-line-follower
description: PID line-following robot: 5-sensor IR array + 2 DC motors (L298N/TB6612). Differential drive with PID steering.

files.content:
# PID Line Follower

Hardware: Arduino Uno/Nano, a 5-channel IR sensor array (A0..A4), an H-bridge (L298N/TB6612), 2 geared DC motors, a battery for the motors (separate from logic, COMMON GROUND).

Tune (see the `pid-control` skill):
1. Set `Ki=0, Kd=0`, raise `Kp` until it follows but wobbles; back off ~30%.
2. Add `Kd` to smooth the wobble.
3. Add a little `Ki` only if it drifts off-center.
Adjust `BASE` for speed, `THRESHOLD` for your surface, and flip `LINE_IS_DARK` if your line is light on dark.

Build: `arduino-cli compile --fqbn arduino:avr:uno line_follower` then `... upload -p COM5 ...`.
